work.author: GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS servus servorum Dei
work.description: Bull XI restores the sees of Giovinazzo and Terlizzi, unites them aeque principaliter with Molfetta and erects their chapters; continuous across artifact pages 20–27 with every running title, page number and provenance line LF1711–1717 excluded; executor Ferretti, derogation, transumpt and Nulli ergo clauses close at the 7 March 1835 dating LF2590–2593, before XII’s numeral LF2596. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS servus servorum Dei at LF1660–1663; the source closing at LF2590–2593 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum anno incarnationis Dominicae millesimo octingente- simo trigesimo quinto, nonas martii, pontifi- catus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
